tasks.short: Understand digging plans and machine limitations

steps.what: Become familiar with digging plans, machine limitations and applicable safe digging procedures

tasks.design: Retain operator familiarization with the actual plan, machine and site. Existing controlled material in {DOCS} supports the briefing; a summary is not evidence that the operator understands the application.
tasks.previous_blocker: Machine limitations and site conditions must be understood together.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest concerns billing records and establishes no automatic familiarization capability.
tasks.still_hard: Conditions can differ from the plan and require clarification before work.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a mismatch between the assignment, the machine and the actual surroundings.
tasks.altitude: Protect the operator's preparation and understanding time.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of construction trades and extraction workers
reach.learn: How site instructions account for equipment and local constraints

evidence.claim: Understanding digging plans and machine limits requires contextual preparation; no measured local software saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is familiarization, excluding plan creation, machine operation and certification. This is a work design, not operational digging guidance.

Supervisors supply current plans and site instructions; equipment owners supply applicable machine information before familiarization closes in s1. The operator checks relevance and asks questions within retained time. No free current-plan, understood-procedure or safe-application flag is assumed; unresolved information goes back for clarification.
Use existing controlled documents and briefing first. No new tool, delegated capture or added upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual plan control and equipment-specific briefing arrangements
research_questions: Which plan-to-site differences require clarification before the operator understands the assignment?

already_counted.description: Plan and machine familiarization with contextual clarification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Familiarization remains human work; billing capability is not transferred to this task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe signals and markings during machine operation

steps.what: Observe hand signals, grade stakes and markings while operating machines to specifications
outputs: operator interpretation and coordinated machine operation

tasks.design: Retain continuous operator observation and response to the actual site. Existing specifications in {DOCS} provide reference; this design adds no camera interpretation or automatic machine control.
tasks.previous_blocker: Signals, visibility and surrounding activity change during operation.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied evidence establishes no validated automatic interpretation or control for this task.
tasks.still_hard: An unclear or conflicting signal requires contextual clarification rather than an inferred instruction.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize uncertainty and coordinate directly with the crew.
tasks.altitude: Live observation and coordination retain their full time.

reach.role: operating engineer and other construction equipment operator
reach.task: Discuss signal ambiguity during coordinated work
reach.learn: How interpretation depends on the actual operation and surroundings

evidence.claim: Live signals and site markings require operator interpretation; no local automatic-control saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is observing and responding during operation, excluding creation of markings and any separate excavation production claim. This is not an equipment-control procedure.

Authorized signalers produce signals during s1 before the operator responds; the responsible site crew establishes markings before use. The operator observes and clarifies within retained time. No free visible-signal, valid-marking or clear-path flag is assumed.
Existing communication and site references remain the means. No new sensing system, work transfer or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual signal arrangements and visibility constraints
research_questions: Which ambiguities require direct crew clarification rather than interpretation from a stored plan?

already_counted.description: Continuous observation, interpretation and crew coordination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Live operator observation remains necessary; no digital capture baseline is invented.

steps.what: Receive written or oral instructions regarding material movement or excavation and clarify uncertainties

tasks.design: Retain direct receipt and clarification of the actual assignment, with written instructions in {DOCS} where already used. A received message or acknowledgement does not establish that excavation instructions are understood or suitable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Oral and written instructions can omit important local context.
tasks.enabler_now: Message routing could deliver information, but the task establishes no separate routing workload or understanding substitute.
tasks.still_hard: Changed or contradictory instructions require clarification with the responsible person.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize what remains unclear and ask the relevant question before relying on the instruction.
tasks.altitude: Protect direct instruction receipt and clarification time.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of construction trades and extraction workers
reach.learn: How to distinguish an instruction from an assumption about the work

evidence.claim: Receiving an instruction includes contextual interpretation and clarification; no measured automation saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is receipt and clarification, excluding original work planning, production and billing. Shared briefing time with familiarization is counted once.

The authorized supervisor produces instructions before or during s1 and answers questions before receipt is treated as understood. The operator verifies source, scope and current relevance within retained time; no free authorized-current-instruction or comprehension flag is assumed.
Use existing written or oral communication first. No added form, new tool or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual instruction authority and change communication process
research_questions: Which recurring instruction gaps require clarification rather than faster delivery?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Receipt and clarification retain their time; routing or transcription time is not assumed.

steps.what: Direct workers placing blocks or outriggers and verify situational concerns with responsible personnel

tasks.design: Keep live worker direction and situational clarification with the responsible operator and crew. Controlled instructions in {DOCS} support their work; this design does not calculate stability or authorize a lift automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support placement depends on actual equipment, conditions and coordinated physical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Billing software in the digest provides no evidence for automatic support-placement direction.
tasks.still_hard: An apparent setup can conceal unresolved conditions requiring qualified assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Observe what is happening, communicate clearly and escalate uncertainty to responsible expertise.
tasks.altitude: Physical coordination and responsibility remain human.

reach.learn: Which questions need qualified site or equipment expertise

evidence.claim: Directing physical support placement requires situational coordination; no measured local automatic direction saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is directing the stated placement work, excluding workers' physical placement labour and any independent engineered lifting assessment. This is not a lifting or stabilization procedure.

Existing instructions and direct communication remain the means. No new system, worker reporting burden or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual equipment requirements and delegated setup authority
